Let me check the details.\n", "t": [["write_file", "{\"content\":\"import time\\nfrom collections import OrderedDict\\n\\n\\nclass LRUCache:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Least-recently-used cache whose entries also expire after a TTL.\\n\\n    Entries are stored in an OrderedDict in order of use (oldest first).\\n    Each value is paired with its absolute expiry time (None if ttl is None).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\\n        if capacity < 1:\\n            raise ValueError(\\\"capacity must be at least 1\\\")\\n        self.capacity = capacity\\n        self.ttl = ttl\\n        self.clock = clock\\n        self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expires_at or None)\\n\\n    def _expired(self, entry, now):\\n        expires_at = entry[1]\\n        return expires_at is not None and now >= expires_at\\n\\n    def _purge_expired(self, now):\\n        for key in [k for k, e in self._data.items() if self._expired(e, now)]:\\n            del self._data[key]\\n\\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\\n        now = self.clock()\\n        try:\\n            entry = self._data[key]\\n        except KeyError:\\n            return default\\n        if self._expired(entry, now):\\n            del self._data[key]\\n            return default\\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\\n        return entry[0]\\n\\n    def put(self, key, value):\\n        now = self.clock()\\n        self._purge_expired(now)\\n        expires_at = None if self.ttl is None else now + self.ttl\\n        self._data[key] = (value, expires_at)\\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\\n\\n    def __len__(self):\\n        now = self.clock()\\n        return sum(1 for e in self._data.values() if not self._expired(e, now))\\n\\n    def __contains__(self, key):\\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\\n        if entry is None:\\n            return False\\n        return not self._expired(entry, self.clock())\\n\",\"path\":\"D:\\\\Projects\\\\local_ai\\\\strata-lab\\\\runs\\\\work\\\\hermes\\\\lru_ttl-1794053108\\\\lru_ttl.py\"}"]]}

Implementation with index-based loop:

def parse_line(line, sep=","):
    fields = []
    cur = ""
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    n = len(line)
    while i < n:
        ch = line[i]
        if quoted:
            if ch == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and line[i+1] == '"':
                    cur += '"'
                    i += 2
                    continue
                quoted = False
            else:
                cur += ch
        else:
            if ch == '"':
                quoted = True
            elif ch == sep:
                fields.append(cur)
                cur = ""
            else:
                cur += ch
        i += 1
    if quoted:
        raise ValueError("unterminated quote")
    fields.append(cur)
    return fields
